description: Privacy-first Islamic companion: Quran, prayer times, Qibla, hadith & more. Noor Connect is a comprehensive, privacy-first Islamic companion — Quran, prayer times, Qibla, hadith, tafsir and more — with zero ads, zero trackers and zero accounts. Everything you use stays on your own device. Quran, Tafsir & Reading • Mushaf reader with 600+ page images and authentic page layout • 26 tafsir editions (Ibn Kathir, Tabari, Qurtubi, Jalalayn…) — read online, or download any edition for fully offline reading • Khatma progress tracking, bookmarks and reading streaks Prayer Times & Adhan • 13 calculation methods (MWL, Umm al-Qura, Karachi, Gulf, Moonsighting, Turkey…) with Hanafi / Shafi'i Asr • Adhan alarms that survive reboot, a different adhan per prayer, and your own uploaded adhan audio • Pre-prayer, post-prayer and prayer-end reminders • Hijri calendar with manual adjustment for local moon sighting Qibla • Precision compass with sensor calibration, manual bearing mode and distance to the Kaaba Hadith & Knowledge • 16 authentic collections (~52,000 hadiths): Bukhari, Muslim, Nasai, Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Mishkat, Malik's Muwatta and more — fully offline, searchable • Daily ayah and daily hadith with reflections Noor Cycle • Fiqh-aware menstrual tracker that pauses prayer reminders during your cycle • 50 fiqh Q&As with sources, pregnancy mode, ghusl checklist and cycle predictions Library & Media • Stories of the Prophets (Qisas) and a 33-chapter Seerah of the Prophet ﷺ • 200+ Islamic e-books from Archive.org with offline reading • 24/7 live Makkah & Madinah streams, Quran radio, recitation audio and copyright-free nasheeds More • Zakat and Fitrana calculators with live gold/silver rates • Qaza tracker, habit tracker, digital tasbeeh and a gamified Islamic quiz • 8 languages: English, العربية, اردو, বাংলা, Русский, Français, 한국어, Türkçe Privacy First No analytics, no trackers, no ads, no accounts. All data — prayer records, bookmarks, cycle logs, habits — stays on your device, protected by automatic local backups and Android's own backup system. Fully open source under GPL-3.0.
